RESOLUTION By THE TREUTLEN COUNTY BOARD OF COMMISSIONERS

A RESOLUTION APPROVING AND SETTING A PROPOSED COUNTY BUDGET FOR THE 2018 FISCAL YEAR

On this day, the 27th day of June 2017, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners have met for the Purpose of discussing and Passing a resolution, setting and approving a proposed County budget for the 2018 fiscal year.

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners believes that it is in the best interests of its citizens to Prepare a budget for the upcoming fiscal year; and

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners is vested with the authority to collect and expend tax revenues in order to provide public services mandated by the Constitution of the State of Georgia and those other needs deemed necessary for the public good; and

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners acknowledges that a budget is necessary in order to determine a millage rate for ad valorem taxes; and

WHEREAS, The Treutlen County Board of Commissioners are required by the O.C.G.A §33-8-8 3 to specify the expenditure of funds derived from the tax imposed by Code Sections 33-8-8.1 and 33-8-8.2 and to specify other revenue used from those expenditures Treutlen County has budget revenues from these funds

of $210,725 and has designated $244,463 in expenditures for fire, sanitation, recycling and recreation to primarily provide for the health, safety and welfare of the unincorporated area of the County. The County has designated an additional $33,500 in unincorporated revenues from Beer tax, Railroad Equalization, Financial Institution and Beer license fees to cover the unincorporated expenditures.

WHEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, such resolution was adopted, and the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners issues the following Resolution:

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners of Treutlen County, Georgia hereby approve and adopt the attached County budgets for the 2018 fiscal year; and

BE IT RESOLVED, that the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners, shall have the authority to amend any part or portion of said budget, as circumstances may require.

This the 27th day of June, 2017

Chairman of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners

Attest:

a County Manager Board of Commissioners
